transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because people have noticed I’m either moving really slowly, like I’m underwater—taking forever to answer or even get out of a chair—or I’m pacing around my apartment, rubbing my hands like I’m trying to shake off a bad call.
Alongside these physical changes, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah. Most of the time since this started, I’ve had this sadness kind of in the background. I feel guilty a lot, and I’m not really interested in much. My sleep’s been off too. Some weeks aren’t as bad, but it’s mostly there.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually high, wired, or full of energy, needing much less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a time where I felt unusually high or had a lot more energy than normal.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about two years now—maybe two years and a month. It lets up briefly sometimes, but it keeps coming back.
Before this two-year period began, had you ever experienced times of depression like this?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having a period like this before then.
During these past two years, what is the longest period of time that you felt completely like your normal self?

Honestly, I don’t think there’s been a stretch where I felt completely back to normal. Some weeks are lighter, but the sadness and guilt, not being interested in things, and the sleep problems are still kind of there in the background.
